# 025-hotel

**Provider.** Rakuten Travel (楽天トラベル), booking notice for a ryokan in Kyoto, in Japanese.

**Format.** Email with HTML and text parts. A plain two-column table of labelled rows (施設名, チェックイン日時, 宿泊代表者氏名 ...) under a red brand bar, a per-night price table, cancellation and property notice sections.

**Why.** Japanese dates with weekday kanji (`2027年11月19日(金)`), a check-in window `15:00～18:00` where the earliest time is taken, a separate expected arrival time (16:00) and dinner time that are not check-in times, and the lead guest printed in Latin capitals surname first (`ISHIKAWA HARUTO 様`) to be turned into "Haruto Ishikawa". The price is per person per night times two guests; only the total is taken, and it is paid at the property with the city accommodation tax on top. The property name is Japanese only, so title and place name stay in Japanese.
